why: A scenario checkpoint conflict must offer the copy recovery action promised by its error message.
verdict: pass for two-tab scenario checkpoint conflict and independent copy
observations: Conflict exposes Save independent copy in the scenario session bar.
Stale Save preserves the newer durable run and retains the exact local snapshot in recovery.
Copy storage-full fault preserves local state, original run identity and newer durable checkpoint; retry succeeds.
Copied run has a fresh ID, copied metadata title, same frozen definition and exact local snapshot. The original run remains unchanged.
Reload is exact when observed before the first simulation frame; normal scenario time advances immediately after loading.
Native session restart preparation/cancellation/write-failure regressions pass.
limits: Direct draft-started scenario tested; frozen-release credit transfer is preserved by code but not exercised in this browser case.
Reload observer holds only named simulation frame callbacks until the public Pause control; startup/artwork callbacks proceed.
Not all autosave/concurrent restart/scratch session races or full release acceptance.
